headline: A 2.0933 Percent Exchange Outflow Pulls $5.237 Billion Off Venues
narrative: Exchanges posted a 24-hour net outflow of $5.237 billion, equal to 2.0933 percent of reserves. Coins left the venues, the accumulation pipe: Bitcoin reserves on exchanges fell 9,303.31 coins over seven days, to 1,256,163.14. Bitcoin traded near 78k as that supply moved off the exchanges.
author: jordan
